nom: The Face Shop Rice Water Bright Enzyme Powder Wash

avis.texte: I have been using this cleanser for a couple weeks and it made my skin feels super smooth and radiant. Will absolutely repurchase it when I run out.

I was skeptical initially because I've never used a powder cleanser, but this cleanser made a believer out of me. It thoroughly cleansed my face, leaving no residue. My face felt clean, refreshed, and hydrated after. A little bit goes a long way.
While it requires quite a bit of the wash to cover your face, it works well and leaves your skin smooth.

avis.titre: This product gave my skin clean moisture for days!!
avis.texte: I have been using this product for almost 2 weeks! My skin has never felt softer and looked more radiant! Absolutely love this product! Never had any redness or issues with it! This is my jew go to cleanser! And I LOVE that its a powder!

i liked this product but i don't feel that it gave me any results - my skin felt clean but not any brighter/more even. I would love for there to be an unscented version - the smell was a little strong especially for my sensitive skin
Great product! You don't need a lot a little goes a long way. You wouldn't think that it would lather up as much as it does but it's amazing. Kept my skin feeling soft and glowy .

I really enjoyed using this product. A little goes a long way and it lathers up nicely. It has the faintest scent that's not bothersome at all. My face feels clean afterwards. It didn't cause me to break out. I received this product for free in exchange for a review.

avis.titre: It feels good on my skin
avis.texte: I really liked this product, it feels good on my skin, I don't notice any smells when I use it either. It doesn't irritate my skin or anything. After washing my face my skin feels softer and no bumps. I think the bottle design might need to be changed as the dispensing hole is too big dispensing more powder than what is needed. It is difficult to not put too much product on the hand. A little goes a long way with this face wash.

I will preface this review by saying my skin type is fairly normal. Occasional breakout and random dryness sometimes. But I Absolutley love this. My skintone is brighter, I love the way it foams up, and it leaves my skin feeling moisturized after using it. I really like the packaging as well, it dispenses easily and doesn't spill everywhere. I will definitely be repurchasing this in the in the future.

avis.titre: Makes my skin feel super smooth and soft
avis.texte: I love how it makes my skin feel afterwards, my skin feels smooth and soft, I also like that it gets very sudsy while your washing your face. I wasn't expecting that at all! The next day I tried it again and my skin felt great but a little dry, I think because this product has a lot of AHAs BHAs ect, you should use every other day or maybe twice a week to get your skin acclimated to it so you don't dry your skin out ;)

I wasn't sure what to expect from a powder cleanser but I've loved it so far. The lather is great and makes my skin feel very fresh and clean. Seeing slight changes to my skin and minimizing breakout even when stressing out majorly this week at work.

avis.titre: Works great leaves skin feeling amazing
avis.texte: I had to eyeball the amount of powder vs water , enough to make a paste. But I did it and made enough to make it work first try no issues. It lathers great. Smells like soap and cleanses way better than expected. It left my 46 year old face feeling amazing! Definitely a game changer. I'm definitely going to use this from now on.
I like how a little powder suds up so much for a nice clean feel with out over drying. After about two weeks I did start to see some brightening effects. My skin looked more even and radiant.

I recently got this for free to review and I honestly would buy it again. I love how i can control the level of exfoliation and this makes my skin feel so clean but never too stripped. I also love the lather!

This product is honestly so cool and different! It comes as a powder, so you just add a little water, and the texture turns out super nice once it's mixed. After using it, my skin feels amazing, kind of like a gentle exfoliation (not sure if that's the right word), but it definitely makes a difference. My face feels super soft, clean, and just healthier overall. Love it! The smell is a little weird not the best fragrance but it's totally fine because the results are worth it. I received this products for free in exchange for my honest review.
This is not as finely ground as other powder exfoliants that I have tried. This has a strong baby powder scent. It doesn't dissolve well in water. I mix a little liquid cleanser with mine also.

The Face Shop sent me their Rice Water Bright Enzyme Powder Wash for free in exchange for an honest review. It took a few tries to find the correct amount of powder and correct amount of water, I found a quarter sized amount of powder works best for me. The powder gives a bit of exfoliation before it turns into a smooth texture that leaves your skin feeling really smooth and clean. It's non-irritating, and really felt like it took the top layer of dead skin away. I loved how my skin felt when using this product consistently- very smooth and clear. It's a bit hard to rinse all the product off, using a washcloth is the way to go. Overall I like this face wash and will keep using it as part of my skincare routine.
I love how different this face wash is so fun that it comes in powder form . my skin feels so smooth and refreshed after using .
Gently exfoliates, helped my skin to look more radiant and evened out my skin tone. Would recommend to others to personally try this product.
This product is great! Ive been obsessed with korean skincare lately and this is definitely a good product! I love that its a very different consistency and it leaves your skin feeling youthful

I used this product as a facial wash and I enjoyed using it. I am familiar with The Face Shop Right Water Bright brand but had never tried the enzyme powder wash. I think it's pretty innovative in the sense that they tell you to add water after pouring some powder to your hands to create a foamy lather to wash your face with. I was expecting it to be harsh but it was actually very gentle on the skin and cleaned very effectively. It leaves your face very clean and bright. You don't need a lot of product and it's surprisingly not messy like you would think. It also provides a nice glow! I was provided this in exchange to an honest review and I would definitely recommend this product and purchase it. I am no stranger to K-Beauty and this product lives up to that!

I was given for my honest review. I have had this product now for a month. Which I've been using daily will 5x a week. I love that it's easy to use even though it's a powdered which I wasn't sure about at first. All you need to do is put some water on your face then use a little and work it around. I didn't feel dry after. With in the last month I have noticed some uneven skin tone go away it's good for pores.

This product makes a great after work face wash. It's the first thing I run to after a full day and I'm never disappointed. It has the scent of baby powder which I think most people will like and makes my skin feel so soft and fresh. It does visibly brighten my skin right away. I was a little hesitant at first as I have never used a powder face wash before but it lathers really well and is easy to use.

avis.titre: This is definitely a product worth buying!!!
avis.texte: This powder wash comes in a bottle that is easy to dispense. Instructions are easy to follow. You mix the powder to create a lather then it's ready to use and leaves your face feeling so moisturized, hydrated, and soft like baby skin!

avis.titre: Might be my new favorite face wash
avis.texte: I'll be honest, I didn't expect much from this wash because of how cutesy the packaging was but wow was I wrong. From the very first wash my skin immediately looked brighter and glowy - my friends have even commented on it! For reference I'm 32 with normal skin on the dry side. So my skin can be temperamental and is prone to flaring up when I try new products or layer acids, of which I used several in my (extensive) skincare routine, this caused no issues even with the acidity. I loved the texture of this cleanser and that it didn't cause a mess to use. I just wet both hands before getting a "serving" of the face wash powder and that's enough moisture to get a full and luxurious lather. I swear there's also a bit of a scrubby feeling - it's subtle but feels SO good. I also have to commend the thoughtful product design. I've used powder cleaners/exfoliants before and they can be so messy. But the way the opening is designed it limits how much comes out at once and you get the perfect amount of cleanser each time. Overall, I'm a total product junkie — especially K-beauty — and was genuinely impressed by this face cleanser. I've tried foaming cleansers from Toboco (very disappointing), Round Lab (super moisturizing), skin1004 (solid), Farmacy (bleh), Laniege (my current main), Good Molecules, fresh, acure, sulwasoo and this one is easily one of my new faves! It's not as moisturizing as Round Lab but I think it does a more thorough job so it balances out.

i'm obsessed with how gentle yet effective this is! my skin feels super smooth after every use. it lathers up to a soft foam, and i get a natural glow without stripping. a great option for sensitive days!

I like how a little goes a long way and it foams up really nice. It does a great job of removing makeup and leaving your skin clean and clear. Don't get the product in your eyes as it burns. The opening of the product is too big you end up pouring more product than what you need. Overall, it's a great and I would try it again. I received this free in exchange for a honest review.

avis.titre: Powder Cleanser Great for Travel - just add water!
avis.texte: **I was gifted this product in exchange for my honest, unbiased review.** When I opened the packaging for The Face Shop's Rice Water Bright Enzyme Powder Wash, I was a little nervous because of the somewhat strong scent. I have pretty sensitive skin and normally need fragrance free products to ensure my face isn't irritated. I haven't used this daily, although I believe you can use it as a daily cleanser. I've been using it twice a week for a few weeks and pleased to report it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin! It's an innovative formula for a cleanser in powder form that you just add a little bit of water to and mix to create a rich creamy foam. My face feels smooth, hydrated and clean after using the Enzyme Powder Wash! I would definitely recommend for its ease of use. It's made in Korea and I'm a big fan of most K-beauty and other Asian beauty brands I've tried. Their skincare and cosmetics have really elegant formulas that don't cause breakouts or irritation to my very picky skin. Many things can cause me to break out in rashes or hives from ingredients, especially fragrance but The Face Shop has a winner in their Rice Water Bright Enzyme Powder Wash! I deducted one star because I do think the packaging could be slightly improved with a way to close back off the powder compartment in addition to the the flip top lid. I could see it potentially spilling in transit if you're not careful how you pack it. Also, if the fragrance was removed, it could be more attractive for th
This made my skin so smooth. I didn't notice my skin tone evening out and brightening a bit too! The only thing bad is the smell is not that great but other than that it's a great product.

I received this product free in exchange for an honest review. I'd never tried a cleanser like this before, and was a little skeptical. Upon first opening I noticed it's a nice elegant package that would be great for travel. Loved the texture and that you can add as much or as little water depending on how much exfoliation you want. The granules dissipate nicely and the smell is neutral. Cleaned my face well, including removing my make-up. I have normal-combination skin, and after using I didn't have any dryness or tightness that I sometimes feel with more harsh cleansers. Overall happy with it and would recommend!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I use this product every night, it is very gentle, it does not have a smell. It leaves my skin soft and clean. I do recommend it.

1 Star Off for the nature of the product being messier than a cream or gel because as with all powder cleansers, you need to know how much water to mix in and how to do it. If not, you risk having a messy application or needing to keep adjusting the ratio of product to water. I usually have a little bit of trouble with this but the bottle's design does help because it has a flip top opening and a specially designed opening that doesn't release a too much product out at once. After finding the right ratio of water to powder, it does foam up into a really nice lather which compares to typical foam cleansers. I liked how it didn't strip my skin and thereby making my skin feel drier or tight. It did feel like it provides a good clean while keeping my skin moisturized. I'm not sure how much it actually brightened my skin and I've noticed that my existing foam cleanser does a better job at that.

Obsessed with this Rice Water Bright Enzyme Powder Wash! It leaves my skin feeling so soft, clean, and fresh without drying it out. I love how it gently exfoliates and gives my skin a natural glow. Definitely a new favorite in my skincare routine!

I'm participating in a BzzAgent campaign and was sent this Rice Water Bright Enzyme Powder Wash free of charge for review. Love the powder format, which allows me to adjust the level of abrasiveness by adding more or less water. Though even using just a tiny amount of water, the abrasiveness is still quite gentle! The powder travels well and doesn't spill everywhere. I don't love the fragrance, but it's inoffensive enough. It's a good wash and gentle polish, but I have not seen any improvements in skin tone, as promised.

I usually stay away from scented skincare, but this rice water enzyme powder wash completely surprised me. The scent is incredibly light, barely noticeable, and didn't irritate my skin at all, which is a big plus. After just over a week of use, I could visibly see a difference in my skin. It looked brighter and felt smoother. I also love the versatility of this product, you can use it as a gentle exfoliator or lather it up in your hands for a softer cleanse. A little truly goes a long way, it lathers up nicely and leaves your face feeling fresh but not stripped. Highly recommend this if you're looking for a gentle yet effective cleanser with a low scent profile. This is definitely a product that I would repurchase and implement into my daily face routine.

avis.titre: I love this product enough to use the whole thing
avis.texte: I like this product a lot! It has a great lather and a soft almost baby powder smell. My skin feels smooth after using it…it does a pretty good job as a second step in my skin cleansing routine

avis.titre: It leaves my skin feeling really smooth
avis.texte: The best part of this product is the fact that it left my skin super. I didn't feel any irritation. A small amount of powder goes a long way. Although it did not brighten my skin the way I thought it would.

I recently tried the Rice Water Bright enzyme powder wash and I'm really impressed. At first, I wasn't sure how I'd feel about using a powder cleanser, but it's actually super easy to use—you just pour a little into your palm, add water, and it turns into a gentle, creamy foam. What I love most is how clean and soft my skin feels afterward. It's super gentle but still does a great job at removing leftover makeup and sunscreen. My skin feels smoother and looks a bit brighter since I started using it consistently. I've also noticed fewer dry patches since using this. The scent is light and fresh and a little goes a long way, so the bottle lasts a while.I definitely recommend for anyone looking for a gentle but effective daily cleanser.

avis.titre: I would buy this product and tell my family about it
avis.texte: This product is amazing! All you need is just a little powder and it goes a long way.

I generally only like to use products that are geared towards sensitive skin. Oftentimes I find that the simpler the product, the better my skin feels after using it. I used the Rice Water Bright Enzyme Powder Wash for the first time yesterday & I was happy with the entire product. The packaging is cute & it was easy to unseal & then open. I had never used powder face wash before, so I wasn't sure what to expect. It lathered nicely and felt so soft on my skin as I applied it. It smelt normal and my skin didn't dry out or seem irritated afterwards which is rare for me with using new products. Would I recommend it to a friend? Definitely!

I'm very pleased with the results after using rice water bright enzyme powder wash. It is was a little different using a powder face wash, I've never done that before. It lathered up very nicely and felt great on my skin. I feel it did a great job at getting deep into my pores to remove dirt oil and makeup. My skin feels great and is very radiant. I'm fully satisfied with the results.

avis.titre: Would recommend as a deep cleanser
avis.texte: This is a great deep cleanser. I use it at night to lift sweat, oils, and dead skin that may reside on my face and this does a great job at making sure I have a fresh palette. I wasn't able to identify the moisturizing factor of this product as it acts as more of a stripper of oils for me, which is fine when I want deep clean. I do like that it's a powder that turns into a cleanser when water is applied. There's no worry of liquid spills when traveling. The one thing I don't like is the design of the package. The powder tends to get all over the lid when you're pouring it out and I have to wipe it off each time.

avis.titre: Amazing results after just one use!!!!!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product!!! From the very first use, my face felt smoother and more refreshed. My pores looked smaller and my skin had a healthy, radiant glow. It's gentle, yet effective and leaves your skin feeling clean without drying it out. This has quickly became part of my skincare routine. Highly recommend if you're looking for smaller pores and smoother skin!!! I received the product in return for my review but I will definitely be purchasing again and again!!!

I have really been getting into Korean skin care lately and was excited to have the opportunity to try this product. I love the tatcha rice polish but hate the price and this product is almost identical to it! I used way too much when I first tried and the powerful AHAs irritated my skin barrier so going forward you only need a little bit of the rice powder to get a great physical exfoliation. My skin was super soft after the application and I will enjoy using this product in my skin care regimen!
This face wash is so fun to use and leaves my skin feeling so clean and soft! I love that it's a powder and turns into a foamy face wash with water.

This is a unique product. It is a grainy powder you pour out onto your hand and lather with water. You can change the consistency by adjusting the amount of water. It is slightly exfoliating, while gentle, and also milky/creamy. It leaves skin feeling hydrated and not stripped and irritated. I don't think this a product you should store in the shower which is the only drawback.

Brand "The Face Shop" kindly gave me "Rice water bright enzyme powder wash" for free so I could review it. I've been loving the Rice Water Bright Enzyme Powder Wash! It turns into a soft foam that gently exfoliates and brightens my skin without any dryness. My complexion feels smoother, looks more radiant, and it's gentle enough for daily use—even on sensitive skin. Plus, it's super travel-friendly. A must-try if you want a gentle glow-up!

I really love this rice water face wash as apart of my morning routine! Even though it is a powder it lathers very nicely and the plus to the powder is it makes it easy to travel with! It also helps brighten my skin and helps build upon the other brightening products I use in the morning.

avis.titre: Clean but can be a little drying
avis.texte: This is my first time using a powder cleanser and honestly, it's pretty cool. I like how you can control exactly how much you use each time. I've been using it daily and it cleans really well, but I did notice it can be a bit drying, so I probably wouldn't use it more than once a day. I also like that it doesn't really have a scent and it doesn't sting my eyes either, which is a big plus.

avis.titre: I like it and would re-purchase!
avis.texte: This reminded me a little bit of Dermalogica Microexfoliant, but when you add water to the powder, it does create more of a wash than a paste. I think it has a little bit of exfoliation power, and it makes your skin feel good and clean. This would be great for traveling b/c it's not a liquid.

I loved this!! I have super dry skin and this cleansed really well, while still keeping my face feeling hydrated. I'd never used a powder cleanser before, but I really liked it. It easily turns to a lather once you add water. Makes it easy to travel with as well!! I would definitely recommend this and will likely be repurchasing. *I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.*
This product makes my feel feel so clean and smooth 9 love it my face feels so clean I want to try other products of this brand I use it everyday since I got it.

This product, Rice Water Bright Enzyme Powder Wash works very well. It's effective on my dry skin. I am easily able to create a light foam without any drying. The powder acts almost like a scrub when added with water and dissolves rather well when massaged into the skin. I received this product in exchange for my review. I honestly never had tried a product like this in my life. It is one of a kind.

This worked well but the instructions were confusing. It just says to put an "appropriate" amount of the product but idk if that's like a shake, pea size, etc. I eyeballed it and it was an ok amount but needed lots of water. Tingled nicely in my cheeks and smelled nice, just wish I knew how to use as intended.
Really enjoying this face wash. Can tell it's really cleaning all my pores. Very gentle too which is super nice for my sensitive skin.

The Face Shop kindly gave me this Rice Water Bright Enzyme Powder Wash product for free so that i could review it. I felt pampered after using this product! The scent initially reminded me of a pleasant slight hint of ivory soap. Not a lot of product is needed to get a good lather; I only needed a dime to quarter sized amount with a couple teaspoons of water. This product is also really great for travel, as you don't have to worry about liquid spilling in your luggage. Immediately after washing my face, it felt really clean and soft. I felt refreshed as well. The product cleans very well without my skin feeling dry or tight. I highly recommend this product!
I immediately noticed softer skin. I double cleanse and used this in the shower so the lathering was great for shower use. Once I dried off my skin left plumper and soft the enzymes do a great job.

Its a good concept with the powder and then adding water but its not something i would use everyday. I use Cerave as I have combo skin and i felt some burning on some new pimples I had. Overall it might be great for others just not my skin.

I am absolutely in love with this rice powder wash. I have never tried a powder wash before and this one works so well and made me fall in love with powder washes. First of all, the bottle is a beautiful pink! It is easy to control the amount of powder that is dispersed from the bottle because of the size and shape of the opening at the top. It mixes well with the water and even foams up a little as well. It has a very natural scent to it, nothing strong at all. It does an amazing job at cleaning my face and then leaving it so smooth and silky. I love the way my skin feels after I use it. It is absolutely wonderful! I can't say enough amazing stuff about this rice water bright enzyme powder wash from The Face Shop! It is my new favorite product! I would highly recommend this to absolutely everyone!

avis.titre: I would buy the enzyme powder face wash over and over again!
avis.texte: Thank you the face shop, clean beauty for the free product! The enzyme powder wash is a great product due to its ability to break down dead skin without harsh scrubbing. This product also is a gentle wash and doesn't irritate the skin. The powder wash leaves a moisturizing finish. This product is different from others because it leaves my face smooth without feeling dry. I would recommend this product because I have oily skin and it reduces the amount of oils produced and it works for all skin types!

I got this for free and this powder wash is great. after you use it you can feel an immediate difference, my face feels smooth especially my nose area where it is usually a little textured. The only downside is the packaging its really easy to over pour and there is always powder on the container
This product was gentle yet effective! I've never used a powder and I was worried but it worked great. I will be using again!!

First, I really like how this face wash smells. I am a bit sensitive to smells, so I always love when I come across a product that does not have a super strong fragrance. This was interesting to use, but I liked it. For me, I poured a shake or two of the powder into my hand, then I added just a little water to make it into a paste type of consistency. From there, I rubbed it onto my face, then I wet my hands and when I rubbed my face it turned the paste into a lather. I lathered for a minute or two and then rinsed. My face felt so nice and refreshed after, and my skin had a nice glow. I would definitely recommend this to those that love to change things up in their skin-care routine. I cycle my products weekly, and I am adding this to my routine.
I love that it leaves your skin smooth and you are able to dilute the powder with the amount of water you want.

This is a powder face wash, which i have not used before. To my surprise it is very convenient to use, simply add some powder to my palm and lather with some water. The product is concentrated, I found maybe 1/2 tsp worth was enough for sufficient wash. This is game changing for traveling bc I can bring this face wash in my carryon. It effectively remove dirt and oil, but didnt strip my face dry. Highly recommend this product! I was given this product in exchange for an honest review.
I really enjoyed this product! It didn't leave my face dry and un-moisturized compared to other cleansers I've tried before.
I would like to say this stuff is amazing, I really like it alot, it's a must have if you wear make up daily or if then it's still a must have
